audience: developers and DevOps teams who build containers and run CI with Depot

useCases.title: Find failed CI runs and their cause
useCases.text: Lists failed Depot CI runs, reads Depot's failure diagnosis, and reads the logs of the failing job.

useCases.title: Find the failing step of a container build
useCases.text: Lists the builds of a project, finds a failed one, lists its build steps with any error, and reads the logs of the failing step.

useCases.title: Check build usage and time saved by cache
useCases.text: Reads the organization's usage over a period, with builds per project, minutes saved and minutes billed, and the cached steps of builds.

useCases.title: Review GitHub Actions jobs on Depot runners
useCases.text: Lists jobs that ran on Depot runners with status and duration, reads job counts and failure rate over time, and searches the log lines.

useCases.title: Check runner size recommendations
useCases.text: Lists Depot's advice to size runners up or down, with the current and suggested size, based on CPU and memory use.

useCases.title: Retry failed CI jobs or cancel a run
useCases.text: Retries one failed job or all failed jobs of a workflow, or cancels a queued or running CI run.
